Reject a missing blob or missing request that was replaced with the same bytes and a different inode at that boundary using WORK_PATH_UNSAFE.
Continue to revalidate the adopted identity and exact bytes at every later retained boundary and on every exception exit.
Preserve blob-first/request-last publication, exact idempotent reuse, missing-blob repair, safe exact-blob orphan behavior, and all accepted standalone staging bytes and return values.
